config.predictive_sample: Accepted tokens from paragraph loci; labels excluded; certain words from incomplete lines retained.

context.caution: This exploratory result measures conditional next-word predictability. It does not establish a language, meaning, authorship, or a translation. Conditioning on paragraph lines, tokenization, transcription choices, folio groups, and exclusion of diagram interruptions can confound the order comparison; the conservative folio groups do not provide a complete codicology map.
